study_identification_part.si_4_title: Probing individual-level structural atrophy in frontal glioma patients

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: 45 glioma patients and 51 age-matched healthy controls recruited from Beijing Tiantan Hospital and local community.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "This study was approved by the Institutional Review Board of Beijing Tiantan Hospital... A final cohort of 45 patients... and 51 age-matched healthy controls... were included in the study."

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The healthy controls from the single site were used to construct the normative brain volume model. The glioma patients were then analyzed using this model to generate individual structural abnormality maps.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "A normative brain volume model was constructed using the healthy controls' data... for each glioma patient, an individual SAM was generated... using the normative model"
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Zhang2022.pdf.md: Methods / Generation of individual structural abnormality map

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: 51 healthy controls were used for the normative model construction. No separate validation/test set of controls is mentioned for the model itself.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "A final cohort of... 51 age-matched healthy controls... were included in the study... A normative brain volume model was constructed using the healthy controls' data."
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Zhang2022.pdf.md: Methods / Subjects; Methods / Generation of individual structural abnormality map

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: Age information for the 51 healthy controls used to build the model. Minimum age inferred from inclusion criteria (> 18 years old).
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.supporting_text: "51 age-matched healthy controls... age = 42.6 ± 9.7 years... Inclusion criteria were adult (> 18 years old)"

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: Sex distribution for the 51 healthy controls (24 men, 27 women). Percentages calculated: Male (24/51)*100 = 47.1%, Female (27/51)*100 = 52.9%.
